scope: Eight bounded arithmetic and array-index contracts through four shell aliases compare original GNU output, status and private file effects. Ordinary diagnostics exercise caller ownership through arithmetic commands, substitutions, assignment, functions and EXIT traps. Native GNU memory findings remain separate

results.name: bash:function-index
args: f(){ local -a a; local key="x+"; ((a[$key]++)); printf unreachable; }; f; printf "outer:%s\n" "$?"

results.name: bash:exit-trap-index
args: trap 'printf exit' EXIT; declare -a a; key='x+'; printf '%s\n' "$((a[$key]))"

results.name: bash:associative-normal
args: declare -A a; key="a b"; a[$key]=3; ((a[$key]++)); printf "%s\n" "${a[$key]}"
